data.title: 埃塔 · 四越百货的建筑图
data.description: 巨大的绘图桌上摊着四越百货的建筑蓝图，埃塔趴在图纸边缘解说结构。年度最佳建筑师的招牌之作，出自这个随时会睡着的精灵之手。
data.location: architect studio with a huge drafting table covered in building blueprints and scale models
data.action: leaning over a giant blueprint pointing at a structural detail, drafting vest, explaining drowsily
data.lighting: 建筑工作室高窗的明亮日光
data.promptProse: Over the blueprint of Mitsugoshi's flagship store, Eta explains load-bearing arches in the tone of someone about to nap.
data.animaCaption: Architect of the Year, they called her. Eta yawned through the ceremony, probably.
